hints.title: Mountain Peak Anchor
hints.text: A mountain triplet requires nums[i] < nums[j] and nums[k] < nums[j] with i < j < k.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Minimums
hints.text: Precompute left_min[j] as the minimum element in nums[0..j-1] and right_min[j] as the minimum element in nums[j+1..n-1].

hints.title: Triplet Sum Evaluation
hints.text: For each candidate peak j, if left_min[j] < nums[j] and right_min[j] < nums[j], update minimum sum with left_min[j] + nums[j] + right_min[j].

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two linear scans for prefix and suffix minimums.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary prefix and suffix arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precompute prefix and suffix minimums to solve in linear time.
